items.title: Alisson wants to sign new Liverpool contract
items.summary: Liverpool goalkeeper Alisson Becker wants to stay at the club beyond the end of the season, when his current contract is set to expire.

items.title: Struggling Sunderland beat Chelsea to move off bottom of Premier League
items.summary: Sunderland held on to their first Premier League win since August as Enzo le Fee's penalty help the hosts sink Chelsea at the Stadium of Light.

items.title: Brighton breeze past 10-man Brentford to move up to second
items.summary: Diego Gomez's long-range strike fires Brighton to a 2-0 over Brentford, who saw Igor Thiago be shown a straight red card, as Fabian Hurzeler's side move up to second in the Premier League.

items.title: Szoboszlai a doubt for Nations League conclusion
items.summary: Liverpool midfielder Dominik Szoboszlai will undergo tests on a knee injury to ascertain his readiness to join up with the Hungarian national side for Nations League fixtures against Georgia and Northern Ireland.

items.title: Were any current Man City players signed during charges period?
